The '''Cedrell system''' was located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Emmo sector/Legends|Emmo sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Cedrellian aged wine]].<ref name="OldFlame">{{WEGCite|story=An Old Flame in Need...|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Cedrellian aged wine]]|system=Cedrell [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cedrell [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
